objective: Preallocate single-table scan data prefixes from table-name length.

tasks.title: Preallocate single-table scan data prefixes
tasks.result: Single-table scan paths now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data:<table>: prefixes.

verification.status: initial compile failed on missing &str borrows; passed after borrow fix: 4/4

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>: before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in materialized query scans, statistics-driven primary-key range bounds, key-only stream projection, and full table scans.
Generated prefix bytes, transaction scan prefixes, range bounds, key-only primary-key projection, row-cache reuse, row decoding, vector fetches, and SQL results are unchanged.
Focused suite tests were launched in parallel and printed Cargo file-lock wait messages before passing.
